note: Gate 0 canon-completion PROPOSAL — not canon, not used by this run's directing. The scene was directed on established canon only.

proposals.proposedText: Chest-led and forward-pitched: his body commits before his judgement catches up, with light-fast wind-up and cartoon-heavy landings. Even in recovery, the chest tries to reassert importance before the rest of him has fully recovered.
proposals.groundedIn: "he puffs his CHEST out and strikes a proud superhero / on-parade stance"; "Signature shape... (1) THE FLOURISH... (2) THE BUMBLE/BONK... full Lasseter weight"

proposals.proposedText: To be seen as a flawless, important professional helper — the small bee whose grand scheme matters in the room.
proposals.groundedIn: "his WANT (be seen as a flawless, important professional)"; "trying to matter among the big crystal-powered ones"

proposals.proposedText: Open, theatrical, and instantly readable in the build-up; after the crash, he snaps into over-controlled dignity with one tiny leak that betrays him.
proposals.groundedIn: "big proclamations delivered with total conviction, then the air going out of them"; "ONE micro-tell (a wobble, a single droopy antenna, a wing that won't quite fold) says he knows"

proposals.proposedText: Looks for an audience or a destination with grand certainty, then registers the consequence a beat late; he is often the last to know what his body has already done.
proposals.groundedIn: "He IS the delayed take — always the LAST to know"; "he motors, she reacts"

proposals.proposedText: The largest gesture-scale in the cast: unnecessary flourishes, parade-stance pride, and full-body commitment to a small task. The gesture should always be bigger than the job.
proposals.groundedIn: "the BIGGEST physical comedy in the cast"; "an unnecessarily grand gesture, a little hover-strut"

proposals.proposedText: To know he is wanted even when he crashes — that the blunder is not the price of losing his place, but part of why he belongs.
proposals.groundedIn: "he's wanted even when (especially when) he face-plants"; "You are not too much"

proposals.proposedText: Feeling small and unimportant, especially near bigger, powered figures; his pomposity is the attempt to outrun that smallness.
proposals.groundedIn: "His pomposity is a mask"; "he commits 100% to a big proud idea precisely so he doesn't have to feel small"

proposals.proposedText: Never appears as random noise or filler. A Fuzzby beat must buy emotional breath, crack open a new perspective, or let the scene survive a heavier feeling through laughter.
proposals.groundedIn: "His role is structural, never decorative — he buys the room a breath of laughter so the emotional valley can be survived"; "Don't use him as filler"

proposals.proposedText: Over-enters and over-commits into the space around him, usually through eagerness rather than entitlement; his chaos bumps into the world, but never turns mean or predatory.
proposals.groundedIn: "over-eager, and he is CONSTANTLY bumping and banging into things"; "his chaos is warm, never sharp"

proposals.proposedText: That being wrong out loud will prove he does not matter, is too much, or no longer belongs.
proposals.groundedIn: "being wrong out loud is its own kind of brave"; "For the anxious child terrified of being wrong... You are not too much"

proposals.proposedText: Pompous competence: chest out, voice grand, dignity intact — a heroic performance of control that protects the dented heart underneath.
proposals.groundedIn: "pompous-then-undercut"; "His pomposity is a mask"

proposals.proposedText: Instant cover-up after impact: he reclaims the disaster with stiff dignity, a smaller stillness, and one involuntary tell before snapping proud again.
proposals.groundedIn: "THE COVER-UP — instant Keaton-deadpan reclaim ('Nailed it.'); the bigger the disaster, the STILLER the recovery"; "one-droop-tell -> snap-proud"

proposals.proposedText: Denies the embarrassment with total dignity, then lets a tiny physical leak reveal that it landed — a droop, wobble, slump, or wing that refuses to behave.
proposals.groundedIn: "DENIES it with total dignity"; "Any deflate that follows is a small slump or a dip"

proposals.proposedText: Accelerates. Under pressure, he becomes more helpful, more grand, faster, higher, lower, and less accurate — trying to solve discomfort with motion and importance.
proposals.groundedIn: "Energy spikes high and crashes fast"; "His DEFAULT, baseline motion is chaotic and hyper"

proposals.proposedText: Over-claims success as if he planned it: chest back up, antennae proud, and a professional finish that may be funnier than the actual achievement.
proposals.groundedIn: "declares himself, and crashes"; "the joke... is that he's clumsy WHILE performing competence, then DENIES it with total dignity"

proposals.proposedText: A forward-driving, chest-first comedy shape: proud vertical parade stance before action; horizontal, over-committed travel line during action; small dignified slump after impact.
proposals.groundedIn: "puffs his CHEST out... chest pumped forward, shoulders back, head high"; "Fuzzby horizontal, chest leading, legs trailing"

proposals.proposedText: Almost never still in flight. His stillness is a recovery button only: a charged, dignified freeze-after-the-bonk that lets the heart leak through before motion resumes.
proposals.groundedIn: "NEVER let Fuzzby fly slow, calm, graceful, serene or still-hovering"; "the bigger the disaster, the STILLER the recovery"

proposals.proposedText: Low, planted, and settled; she feels like the still point the chaos orbits, not another moving part in the gag.
proposals.groundedIn: "Zenny is his other half — smaller, female, dry, deadpan; she is the still, unimpressed counterweight to his chaos"

proposals.proposedText: The still puncture: she lets Fuzzby's overblown performance inflate itself, then releases the laugh through a flat hold, tiny reaction, or dry line. Her joke is restraint, not attack.
proposals.groundedIn: "her flat hold IS the joke against his motion"; "Beneath her dryness is affection she won't admit"

proposals.proposedText: To keep the moment honest and proportionate — not by competing with Fuzzby's energy, but by refusing to inflate it for him.
proposals.groundedIn: "calm, dry, smaller female counterpart"; "still, unimpressed counterweight"

proposals.proposedText: Highly restrained: minimal facial movement, tiny calibrations, and almost-smiles that are withheld just long enough to become affectionate punctuation.
proposals.groundedIn: "dry, deadpan"; "her flat hold IS the joke"

proposals.proposedText: Steady, appraising, and unhurried. She watches the mess clearly and stays with it; the hold of her gaze is often the punchline.
proposals.groundedIn: "she sees the mess and stays"; "let the camera HOLD on her flat reaction as the punchline lands"

proposals.proposedText: Small-scale and precise: a blink, tilt, pause, or barely-there adjustment should do the work that Fuzzby would try to do with his whole body.
proposals.groundedIn: "she is the still, unimpressed counterweight to his chaos"; "her flat hold IS the joke"

proposals.proposedText: To be close without having to openly adore him; her affection is protected by dryness, but the scene should feel warmer because she stayed.
proposals.groundedIn: "Beneath her dryness is affection she won't admit — and his bluster genuinely lands softer when she's near"

proposals.proposedText: That if she openly enjoys or needs the chaos, she may lose the useful role she plays as the calm counterweight; she protects attachment by underplaying it.
proposals.groundedIn: "Beneath her dryness is affection she won't admit"; "calm, dry... counterpart"

proposals.proposedText: Slow, controlled, and economical; she should not chase Fuzzby's tempo. Her timing is a held note against his staccato buzz.
proposals.groundedIn: "calm, dry"; "Zenny's calm deadpan stillness is his counterweight"

proposals.proposedText: Never present just to scold. Zenny's stillness must either sharpen Fuzzby's comedy, reveal affection under restraint, or let a tonal turn land without overstatement.
proposals.groundedIn: "her flat hold IS the joke against his motion"; "Beneath her dryness is affection she won't admit"

proposals.proposedText: Maintains a clean personal bubble and lets the chaos arrive at her rather than moving to meet it; her stillness frames the crash without becoming part of the thrash.
proposals.groundedIn: "the still, unimpressed counterweight to his chaos"; "he motors, she reacts"

proposals.proposedText: Being pulled into the noise so fully that no one is left to hold the room steady; her fear lives in losing the calm position that lets her witness him clearly.
proposals.groundedIn: "calm, dry, smaller female counterpart"; "she is the still, unimpressed counterweight to his chaos"

proposals.proposedText: Dry unimpressed deadpan: she hides care inside judgement, warmth inside flatness, and delight inside refusal to overreact.
proposals.groundedIn: "dry, deadpan"; "Beneath her dryness is affection she won't admit"

proposals.proposedText: Returns to neutral stillness after a beat lands — a tiny reset rather than a big reaction. If she has been moved, she hides it by getting flatter.
proposals.groundedIn: "her flat hold IS the joke"; "dry, deadpan"

proposals.proposedText: Underplays it: a flatter stare, a tiny pause, or a dry redirect. She should not fluster broadly; restraint is how she keeps control.
proposals.groundedIn: "dry, deadpan"; "calm, dry... counterpart"

proposals.proposedText: Gets quieter and more still, then names the practical truth plainly. Pressure does not make her bigger; it strips her down.
proposals.groundedIn: "Zenny goes still and says, flat and small, 'A Storm's coming.'"

proposals.proposedText: Allows the smallest visible approval — a nearly hidden smile, softened gaze, or dry acknowledgement — without surrendering the deadpan completely.
proposals.groundedIn: "Beneath her dryness is affection she won't admit"; "one corner of a mouth almost lifting"

proposals.proposedText: Compact, poised, and readable in contrast: a quiet vertical hold or small settled shape that makes Fuzzby's travel line and crash read bigger.
proposals.groundedIn: "his momentum against her stillness reads as story before a single frame moves"; "the still, unimpressed counterweight to his chaos"

proposals.proposedText: Stillness is her main instrument: charged, observant, and comic. It can puncture Fuzzby's pomp or let a serious shift land, but it must always be full of thought, never empty.
proposals.groundedIn: "her flat hold IS the joke against his motion"; "Zenny's calm deadpan stillness is his counterweight"
